announced on Wednesday that it priced a $1.5B
of junior subordinated notes, consisting of $700M of 6.750% Series A Notes and $800M of 7.000% Series B Notes, both due in 2056.
The notes were priced at 100% of face value.

Interest rates of the notes will reset every five years after the respective first reset dates in 2031 and 2036, based on the five-year U.S. Treasury rate plus a spread, with a floor at the initial rates.
The offering is expected to close on September 14, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.

The company plans to use the net proceeds, along with cash on hand and commercial paper borrowings, to redeem all outstanding Series A around September 14 and Series B Preferred Units around October 9, including accrued and unpaid distributions.
